title: reyemtech/laravel-hubspot — Design
summary: Approved architecture/design spec for a Laravel package wrapping the HubSpot CRM API via the SDK's generic objects and v4 associations APIs.
notes: Manifest-declared SPEC, precedence 1; content confirms (status Approved, implementation contracts, API surface tables). Extraction flags: §13 proposed six-phase breakdown with non-optional Phase 0 first; §6.4 open empirical question (association inverse) with prescribed probe procedure, not a reasoned decision; §14 defers open decisions to STANDARDS.md; §6 and §8 carry hard constraints — per-direction association typeIds and webhook signature verification that must not use fullUrl().
